title: Tickets now on sale for return of Pinoy musical ‘Zsazsa Zaturnnah’
summary: Tickets are now on sale for "Zsazsa Zaturnnah Ze Parteeeh!," the highly anticipated 20th anniversary production of one of Philippine theater's most iconic and beloved musicals.
